verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the documented 'Drop Logs' capability, which filters out unwanted logs to reduce costs, plus a pre-storage log pipeline builder. Together these give some deliberate control over log volume, but nothing covers trace sampling or retention tiers. Missing for 10: trace sampling controls (head/tail sampling configuration), configurable retention periods or tiers for traces and logs, independent or hands-on corroboration of volume management.
